claims.text: An SBOM (software bill of materials) is a machine-readable list of the components inside a piece of software, each with name, version and kind (e.g. NuGet package, OS package).
claims.source_hint: CycloneDX specification overview (components: name, version, purl, type); glossary entry sbom

claims.text: Syft reads a built image and writes its SBOM; `syft scan docker:<image>` reads the image from the Docker daemon (here reached through the mounted socket); `--output cyclonedx-json` writes CycloneDX JSON to standard output; `--quiet` suppresses all logging output.
claims.source_hint: Syft README / docs: Usage (scan, docker: source scheme), Output formats (cyclonedx-json), --quiet

claims.text: CycloneDX is a published standard SBOM format with a JSON form; a tool that reads CycloneDX can use the SBOM file without the image.
claims.source_hint: CycloneDX specification (cyclonedx.org/specification/overview); no versions.yaml key yet (see open_questions)

claims.text: Each package Syft catalogs carries a package URL (key purl in the JSON) whose type names its kind: pkg:deb/... for a package from the dpkg database, pkg:nuget/... for a .NET package.
claims.source_hint: package-url purl-spec PURL-TYPES (deb, nuget); Syft CycloneDX output (components[].purl); outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/sbom.txt

claims.text: Ubuntu uses the Debian package format (deb); the .NET 10 aspnet base image used by Đơn Hàng is Ubuntu-based, so its OS packages appear as pkg:deb components.
claims.source_hint: .NET docs / mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet image tags (10.0 default tag OS = Ubuntu); DECISIONS.md §3 E1 'base image Ubuntu 24.04'

claims.text: Syft finds OS packages in the installed-package database (dpkg status) and .NET packages in deps.json files: the published app's (/app/DonHang.Api.deps.json), and the .NET runtime's own in the base image (the two *.Runtime.linux-x64 entries).
claims.source_hint: Syft docs: capabilities dpkg, dotnet (dpkg-db-cataloger, dotnet-deps-binary-cataloger); examples/don-hang sbom/donhang-api.cdx.json syft:location paths

claims.text: The api image holds the base image's OS packages plus the one the Dockerfile installs (libgssapi-krb5-2 and its libraries), the published app, and the NuGet packages it needs, direct and transitive.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 DonHang.Api/Dockerfile:48-54 (FROM aspnet:10.0, apt-get install libgssapi-krb5-2, COPY --from=build /app); outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/sbom.txt

claims.text: sbom.sh @ stage-3 lines 18-42: Syft image pinned by digest (v1.54.0), docker run with /var/run/docker.sock mounted; counts components by purl type; prints NuGet purls not in Directory.Packages.props, skipping DonHang.* names (line 40); in the api SBOM that is only DonHang.Api.

Captured output at stage-3: donhang-api:stage-2 SBOM has 102 pkg:deb and 34 pkg:nuget components; 20 NuGet packages not in Directory.Packages.props, including Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 8.19.2 and System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt 8.19.2.

In DonHang.Api/packages.lock.json @ stage-3, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer (Direct) depends on Microsoft.IdentityModel.Protocols.OpenIdConnect 8.19.2, through which the IdentityModel token packages arrive as transitive dependencies.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 DonHang.Api/packages.lock.json (JwtBearer entry lines 5-13 and Microsoft.IdentityModel.* Transitive entries)

claims.text: ci.yml @ stage-3 lines 117-130: the image job runs scripts/devops/sbom.sh on every image in $IMAGES (built earlier in the job, lines 107-115), then actions/upload-artifact uploads sbom/*.cdx.json as artifact 'sboms'.
Directory.Packages.props @ stage-3 names packages for all Đơn Hàng projects including test packages (xunit, Testcontainers.*), and contains no IdentityModel entry (grep -c IdentityModel prints 0).
pubspec.lock belongs to DonHang.App (the Flutter app), which is not part of the api image built from DonHang.Api/Dockerfile.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 DonHang.App/pubspec.lock; DonHang.Api/Dockerfile COPY lines 13-25

claims.text: Making the SBOM with Syft does not compare components against vulnerability data; sbom.sh only reads the image and writes the list. Vulnerability matching is a separate step (Grype, next lesson).
claims.source_hint: Syft README (SBOM generation; vulnerability scanning is Grype's job); scripts/devops/sbom.sh

claims.text: An SBOM's value shows when a flaw is published in one version of a package: searching stored SBOMs for name and version answers which images hold it, instead of rebuilding or guessing from project files.

Try it: sbom.sh with no argument reads donhang-api:stage-2 (built by docker compose build api); it prints pkg:deb and pkg:nuget kinds and lists Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 8.19.2; without the image it exits with a message to build it first (lines 10-15).
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 scripts/devops/sbom.sh:10-15; outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/sbom.txt; docker-compose.yml api image name
